first_browser_failure: The disabled-project option was absent because the existing scope directory deliberately defaults to enabled projects. Added an explicit read-only picker switch using the existing enabled=false API. Creation selectors retain their default. Preserved channel-browser-first-failure.json, channel-browser-first-cleanup.json and the phase log; all owned resources were cleaned.
source_review: Before the first full suite, corrected a void-return session.refresh call in the new view. After the full backend suite, corrected picker selection and release of an aborted approval-read busy flag; only Channels.vue and ScopeSelect.vue changed, followed by final frontend, browser, native protocol and exact-candidate installation validation.
local_preparation: Two local generator commands failed before writes (a Python literal escape and a function-name anchor). Corrected them and reran; initial Ruff found four one-line statement separators in the new test, then formatting and final static validation passed.
browser_expected_cancellation: Held reads are intentionally cancelled. Any route cancellation output is diagnostic; final browser page errors are empty and both contexts/browser and owned API/database/private files are removed.
second_browser_failure: The actual picker timeout was detected but its message lived inside a hidden empty dropdown. Moved the error outside the popup so it remains visible. Preserved channel-browser-timeout-failure.json and cleanup evidence; final browser checks require visible errors rather than weakening the assertion.
picker_interaction: Further attempts exposed an unstable popup checkbox and missing historical selection after the mode changed. Moved the mode control outside the popup and cancel obsolete option reads before reopening the selector. Failed phase logs and channel-browser-picker-control-failure.json remain; final checks use visible labels and require the actual historical option.
empty_selector_recovery: The historical directory returned correct data but an empty remote select suppressed its popup and cancelled the next option read. Added an explicit empty slot so loading, no-match and reopen stay visible. Preserved channel-browser-empty-reopen-failure.json and channel-browser-empty-reopen-cleanup.json. Final desktop and mobile checks require a genuine empty search followed by clearing the query and selecting the historical project.
browser_driver_target: After all desktop read checks passed, the driver clicked the readonly native combobox input under its visible placeholder. Targeted the normal visible select wrapper for node/GPU selection without force, bypass or changing the application. Preserved channel-browser-driver-target-failure.json and cleanup.
browser_fixture_address: The browser fixture submitted an address with a path, which the existing server correctly rejected. Changed the scenario to assert that visible rejection, then submit a valid origin-only address. No server rule was weakened. Preserved channel-browser-fixture-address-failure.json and cleanup.
browser_logout_target: The driver used visible text for logout instead of the existing accessible name 退出登录. Corrected the role locator; application logout was unchanged. Preserved channel-browser-logout-target-failure.json and cleanup.
visual_review: After the first 24-group browser pass, screenshot review found the fixed action column obscured the channel on a 390px screen. Removed only its fixed positioning and reran frontend and all 24 browser groups, requiring the mobile channel-name link to open details. Native backend protocol source hashes remain unchanged; no extra backend rerun was needed for this template-only refinement.
